note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Make each project show a demo and a QA path
purpose: Every software project should show a stable proof surface and a governed route from a candidate demo through QA to a verified release. The first slice is a QA queue that shows what can be tested now, where to open it, and whether the exact revision has been signed off.
serves: The Project outcome of the operator checking and approving work without holding every project in mind.
done_when: For each active candidate, the operator can open its demo, see the test steps and evidence, record a verdict against that exact revision, and see a release path that depends on that verdict.
reading_note: Draft: 4 of the 11 Actions are done. The rest, including the release path, are still open.

actions.title: Give the operator one QA queue for active candidates
actions.why: One list of what can be tested now answers what to check first, without searching across projects.
actions.done_when: The dashboard's QA tab lists every active candidate in a clear order, marks candidate and stable apart, and shows each one's link, test steps and evidence age.

actions.title: Give pull requests one independent review path
actions.why: A separate reviewer of the exact pull request revision gives the operator an independent check.
actions.done_when: The QA command reviews one pull request against its exact starting revision, using read-only evidence and the least costly suitable reviewer.

actions.title: Refuse pull request reviews that are not ready
actions.why: Avoids wasted model calls and noisy checks on drafts or pull requests with pending or failed checks.
actions.done_when: A draft, missing, pending or conflicting pull request is refused before any reviewer is invoked, and the refusal names every blocker.

actions.title: Show one demo card at the top of the project page
actions.why: Gives the operator a single clear next step per project, rather than several competing actions.
actions.done_when: The project page shows one demo summary above its existing controls, with a single primary next action.

actions.title: Collect proof screenshots and deployment records automatically
actions.why: Keeps proof of what was shown current, so an old screenshot is not taken as proof of today's work.
actions.done_when: Each proof capture records its target, revision, time and result, and a stale image is marked as not current proof.

actions.title: Open a test target only after checking it is healthy
actions.why: Stops the operator being sent to a dead or unreachable target as if it were ready.
actions.done_when: Test checks health before opening the target, and an unreachable target is never shown as ready.

actions.title: Show each card's own recorded verdict
actions.why: A verdict should apply to the revision it was given for, so an older result is not mistaken for a current one.
actions.done_when: A recorded verdict updates its card without a reload and names its revision and time, and a verdict for an earlier revision reads as stale.

actions.title: Make fail and follow-up verdicts create different records
actions.why: A failed check should become a tracked Action, while an unresolved question should become an open question.
actions.done_when: A fail verdict creates one open Action on the project, a follow-up verdict creates one open question, and a pass creates neither.

actions.title: Set up Arcadia QA as an independent check
actions.why: Verification should come from a party separate from the one that built the work.
actions.done_when: QA runs against an unchanging candidate revision, and every result is pass, fail or not checked with a reason, never an unexplained pass.

actions.title: Add release steps from a QA-passed candidate to client delivery
actions.why: Ties a release to the exact revision QA approved, while merge and deployment still need the operator's decision.
actions.done_when: A release is ready only with QA evidence for the same revision, and a changed revision returns to candidate and needs QA again.

actions.title: Extend the demo and QA contract across software projects
actions.why: Brings every software project onto the same proof path, while leaving each provider's differences to its own configuration.
actions.done_when: Each active software project either has a configured proof surface or a visible reason its current work cannot be demonstrated.
